t: A plug-on board that gives a Raspberry Pi Pico clear stereo sound.
steps: Buy the pack from PiShop.us, Micro Center, The Pi Hut, or Pimoroni.
Get a Raspberry Pi Pico with male headers soldered on.
Plug the Pico into the back of the pack.
Install CircuitPython on the Pico by dragging its UF2 file over USB.
Follow the Adafruit Pico I2S MP3 guide for a first song.
Set the I2S pins to GP10, GP11, and GP9 in the code.
Plug in headphones and press play.
meta: Open Board. From $15.99. A few stores.
